The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses TECHNICAL SPECIFICATION OF CENTRIFUGAL BLOWERS FOR SP-1 MANUAL SINTER POTS Sr No: 1 ITEM CODE: 60211009001051 Description: CENTRIFUGAL BLOWER 10 HP-Industrial centrifugal, belt-driven, single-inlet single-width (SIS W) ID blower, with the following specifications: Capacity: Approximately 2,500 m³/h per blower. Static Pres sure: 500 mmWC nominal; supplier to submit performance curve covering the 300–600 mmWC range. Mot or: 10 HP (7.5 kW), 415 V, 3-phase, 50 Hz, TEFC, IP55. Operating Temperature: Suitable for continuous ha ndling of hot, dust-laden gases up to 200°C. Material of Construction: MS fabricated casing and impeller su itable for the specified operating temperature. Suction Inlet: 160 mm ID, flanged. Discharge Outlet: Size a nd orientation as per manufacturer's design, subject to purchaser's connection requirements. Drive and Ac cessories: Belt drive, pulleys, shaft, bearings, belt guard, foundation frame, inspection access and drain pl ug. Balancing: Impeller to be statically and dynamically balanced as per applicable standards. Performanc e Guarantee: Supplier shall specify and guarantee airflow, static pressure, fan RPM and absorbed power at the specified operating temperature, and confirm motor adequacy and material suitability. Flanges: Final i nlet/outlet flange dimensions and bolt-hole patterns shall be mutually agreed upon before manufacture. QTY:- 4

UNIT:- Nos Special Terms & Conditions 1) DELVERY PERIOD: 1 MONTH FROM DATE OF PO 2) DOCUMENTS REQUIRED: WARRANTY CERTIFICATE, TEST CERTIFICATE, IMPELLER DRAWING 3) INSPECTION CRITERIA: AS PER SPECIFICATIONS 4) INSPECTION PLACE: AT CFP, CHANDRAPUR 5) PAYMENT TERMS: AS PER SAIL P-1 6) PACKING: The items shall be securely packed in suitable protective packaging to prevent damage, defor mation, or corrosion during handling, storage, and transportation. 7) MARKING: Each package shall be clearly marked with the material description, size/specification, quanti ty, purchase order number, and consignee details 8) THE TENDERER WILL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR BUILDING AWARENESS AMONG THEIR CONCERNED EMPLOY EES ABOUT THE APPLICABLE RULES REGARDING ENVIRONMENT 9) ALL OTHER TERMS & CONDITIONS AS PER SAIL P1. --------------------------------------- Instruction to bidders: Bidders are advised to check applicable GST on their own before quoting. Buyer will not take any responsi bility in this regards. GST reimbursement will be as per actuals or as per applicable rates (whichever is low er), subject to the maximum of quoted GST %. Bidder shall submit the following documents along with their bid for Vendor Code Creation: a. Copy of PAN Card. b. Copy of GSTIN. c. Copy of Cancelled Cheque. d. Copy of EFT Mandate duly certified by Bank. Supplier shall ensure that the Invoice is raised in the name of Consignee with GSTIN of Consignee only. While generating invoice in GeM portal, the seller must upload scanned copy of GST invoice and the screen shot of GST portal confirming payment of GST. SAIL P1 is applicable ----------------------------------------------------------------------- Eligibility Criteria: Bidders shall have successfully supplied similar industrial centrifugal blowers/fans dur ing the last seven (07) years, supported by self-attested copies of purchase orders and completion certific ates issued by Central/State Government organizations, PSUs, Joint Venture Companies having at least on e Central/State Government organization or PSU as a partner, or Public Limited Companies . 3.
